target.mission: ClayCode as a real programming language with compiler, virtual Clay Machine, self-contained zero-install Clay environment, deep/direct Linux interoperability, general Internet/network connectivity, direct process/terminal execution, low-latency Clay data transformation, typed visual/image/video and audio transport, first-class optical/visual signal output, and a minimal ClayOS

CLAY_MACHINE.label: Clay Machine
CLAY_MACHINE.completion_law: PASS only when the canonical ClayCode language/compiler/runtime executes real programs in the virtual Clay Machine; the Clay environment interacts with Linux through explicit typed boundaries; the minimal ClayOS boots/runs its defined scope with reproducible tests and receipts; ClayCode emits/receives a canonical typed visual/optical signal through a deterministic sink and at least one concrete adapter; a copied self-contained Clay environment starts on a fresh compatible Linux target without a mandatory installation step; a canonical Clay program connects to a real network/Internet endpoint; a canonical Clay process/PTY path executes a real Linux executable without an implicit hidden shell/harness; representative ordinary ingress data is transformed into Clay-native typed streams with measured low overhead; image/video traverse the visual plane; and audio traverses its declared media boundary. Component, synthetic or out-of-path host success does not imply whole-machine PASS.

superseded_programs.law: Legacy Frank/self.root/UCM2/harness paths may contribute bounded implementation or regression evidence when semantics still match, but they do not select active work or define current completion.

trigger_target_rule: Every registered project trigger is a lens on CLAYVERSE_CLAY_MACHINE_ONLY and must re-enter ClayCode/compiler/VM/environment/Linux-interop/ClayOS/connectivity/portability/terminal/data-plane/media/typed-visual-signal code, tests, architecture, work items, or explicit negative results. Exact go must load the fixed capability plan, preserve each capability stream's status/blockers, include them in frontier selection, and produce a concrete research/falsification/build/test/runtime delta in that family whenever an unblocked high-information step exists.
